name: Hadaka no Okurimono
source:
An original doujin adventure game.
An erotic fantasy adventure game where you play with boys.

In this ordinary, heartwarming light fantasy world, peace is so prevalent that adventurers are treated as mere hobbyists.
What kind of "gift" will the protagonist, one of these adventurers, receive in the port town he casually visits...?

[Translated from https://www.suruga-ya.jp/product/detail/186014427]

Illustrator: Ueda Yuu / Tokuda (上田裕 / とくだ)
